title: A Cech completion model for the actual residue kernel on the slice
statement: Let X be a scheme, A a commutative Noetherian ring, J an ideal, U a coefficient-sized pro-etale object, and R the completed coefficient ring restricted to U, with residue projection q_0 [def-sfb-adic-residue-lift-comparisons]. The module of the ideal ker(q_0) is of finite type. There exist a complex K of R-modules and augmentation epsilon:K -> R[0] with the augmented local extended Cech description for this ideal [def-weil-pbc-local-extended-cech-description]. For every M in D(R) satisfying ConstantCompletion.IsComplete(q_0,M), the actual augmentation-induced map M -> RHom(K,M) [def-weil-pbc-ringed-completion-unit] is invertible.

proof.text: Choose a finite generating family for J. The flat_and_quotients sections formula identifies the kernel of the restricted residue projection on each slice object with the ideal spanned by the images of these generators. The existing ideal_finiteType_of_span constructs finite local generating sections. No completion witness is chosen in a definition.

The sectionwise inclusion of the kernel is monic, by subtype extensionality. Apply the existing global extended-Cech model and its reflector theorem to that very kernel. Its unit-isomorphism clause applies to the unchanged local completeness predicate.

theorem adicResidueCompletionModel_exists
    (X : Scheme.{u}) {A : Type (max v (u + 1))} [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (J : Ideal A) (U : coefficientProEtaleSiteModel.{u, v} X) :
    let R := (completed (coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X) A J).over U
    let I := kernelIdeal (adicResidueLocalProjection.{u, v} X J U 0)
    ∃ (K : ringedSiteComplex R) (ε : K ⟶ ringedSiteRingComplex R),
      HasLocalExtendedCechDescription R I.module I.inclusion K ε ∧
      ∀ M : AdicResidueLocalDerived.{u, v} X J U,
        IsComplete (adicResidueLocalProjection.{u, v} X J U 0) M →
          IsIso (ringedCechCompletionUnit R K ε M)
